svg.text: Frontend (HTML/CSS/JS or React) → Express.js API → MySQL · Same pattern works for Student, Hospital, Employee, Inventory systems

g.text: User clicks "View Books" in the UI
Business logic prepares the DB query
Result set goes back to the controller
JS renders the JSON into the page

svg.text: Relationship: Student (1) ──< Transactions >── (1) Book · many-to-many via transactions
Layers: routes → middleware → controllers → database config

g.text: The frontend provides the user interface. It communicates with the Express.js backend through RESTful APIs. Express routes receive requests and middleware performs
authentication and validation. Business logic processes the request and communicates with MySQL. The database stores users, students, books and transaction
information. The backend returns JSON responses to the frontend.

svg.text: Swap the entities (Students, Books, Transactions) for Employees, Patients, Products, Courses etc. and the same architecture applies.
